raw_segments.text: Three, Pano V. Three. Listen, Paney, I see you're a sensible man. Take three thousand
and go to the devil and rubble-ski with you, D.U. here. But at once, this very minute,
and forever. You understand that, Paney, forever. Here's the door you go out of it. What have
you got there? A great coat, a fur coat? I'll bring it out to you. They'll get the horses
out directly, and then, goodbye, Paney.
